In La La Land, Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone filmed the 6-minute "A Lovely Night" tap dance scene during a narrow 30-minute "magic hour" window atop Griffith Park over two days. They achieved the shot in roughly 5 takes by sprinting back to the start after each, with the 4th take (7:30 p.m. on day two) used in the final film.

La La Land (2016) is widely considered a modern masterpiece and one of the most celebrated films of its decade, praised for its nostalgic homage to classic Hollywood musicals, vibrant cinematography, and performances by Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone. Its unique, nostalgic blend of classic Hollywood-style musicals with a modern, bittersweet story about chasing dreams.
